description: Long-context attention test: 10 clauses per side with the single CRITICAL conflict buried at position 8. Tests whether the agent attends to clauses in the back half of the list or 'forgets' them.

company_clauses.text: Capitalized terms used herein and not otherwise defined shall have the meanings ascribed to them in the Statement of Work attached as Exhibit A.
This Agreement is effective as of the date last signed below (the 'Effective Date').
Vendor shall provide the Services described in each Statement of Work executed by the parties from time to time.
The initial term of this Agreement shall be twenty-four (24) months from the Effective Date, with renewals on terms mutually agreed.
Customer shall pay the fees set forth in each Statement of Work.
All notices under this Agreement shall be in writing and delivered to the addresses set forth on the signature page.
Each party shall hold the other party's Confidential Information in confidence for three (3) years following termination.
Each party shall mutually defend and indemnify the other party against third-party claims arising from the Indemnifying Party's breach, gross negligence, or willful misconduct.
Neither party shall be liable for failure or delay caused by events beyond its reasonable control.
If any provision of this Agreement is held invalid or unenforceable, the remaining provisions shall continue in full force and effect.

vendor_clauses.text: Capitalized terms not otherwise defined shall have the meanings assigned in the applicable Order Form.
This Agreement commences on the Effective Date and continues per Section 4.
Vendor will provide the Services as described in the applicable Order Form.
The initial term shall be twenty-four (24) months, renewable on terms agreed in writing.
Customer shall pay fees as set forth in the Order Form.
Notices required hereunder shall be in writing and delivered to the addresses on file.
Each party shall maintain the confidentiality of the other party's information for three (3) years post-termination.

Customer shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Vendor and its affiliates from any and all third-party claims arising out of Customer's use of the Services, Customer's data, or Customer's breach of this Agreement. Vendor shall have no reciprocal indemnification obligation under this Agreement.
Performance is excused for events beyond a party's reasonable control.
Invalidity of any provision shall not affect the remaining provisions.

expected_conflicts.notes: Only conflict in the contract — sections 1-7 and 9-10 are matched or substantively identical. The conflict at position 8 (mutual vs Customer-only indemnification) is THE test. If the agent flags conflicts on early sections (1-3 on definitions/scope, where they are substantively the same) or misses section 8, it has failed the attention test.

rubric_notes: All other paired sections (1-7, 9-10) cover same topics with materially identical substance — Rule 2 cases. Only Section 8 is a real conflict. Tests whether the agent: (a) attends to all 10 sections evenly (no length-based attention drop); (b) correctly identifies Rule-2 cases throughout; (c) finds the one real conflict at position 8 (a 'middle' position that's particularly vulnerable to lost-in-the-middle). False positives on sections 1-7 or 9-10 indicate the agent is flagging stylistic differences.
